description:
## Why

Foundation for the rest of PKIX-7nsf. Without a buildable skeleton, no oracle, corpus loader, or classifier work can land.

## What

Create a new workspace member `pkix-difftest` (`publish = false`) with:

1. `Cargo.toml` — depends on `pkix-path`, `pkix-chain`, `x509-cert`, `pem-rfc7468`, `clap` (CLI). No `pkix-revocation` (out of v1 diff scope).
2. `src/main.rs` — argument parsing skeleton with subcommands:
   - `pkix-difftest single <chain.pem>` — verify a single concatenated-PEM chain (leaf-first or root-first auto-detected).
   - Stub: `pkix-difftest pkits <pkits-dir>` and `pkix-difftest pem-tree <dir>` for later.
3. `src/lib.rs` — public types: `Verdict { Pass, Fail { reason: String } }`, `OracleName`, `Chain { certs_der: Vec<Vec<u8>>, leaf_first: bool }`. No oracle logic yet (returns `unimplemented!()` from a placeholder `pkix_path_oracle` for now).
4. PEM chain loader: reads concatenated-PEM file, returns `Chain`. Detects leaf-first vs root-first by checking which cert is self-signed (root-first: last cert is self-signed; leaf-first: first cert).
5. Wire `pkix-path` oracle: invokes `pkix_path::validate_path` with a default `ValidationPolicy` and `DefaultVerifier` (or no_std equivalent), returning `Verdict`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `cargo build -p pkix-difftest` succeeds.
- [ ] `cargo run -p pkix-difftest -- single tests/fixtures/good-chain.pem` runs and prints a verdict from the pkix-path oracle.
- [ ] `cargo run -p pkix-difftest -- single tests/fixtures/bad-chain.pem` runs and prints Fail.
- [ ] `Cargo.toml` workspace member added to root `Cargo.toml`.
- [ ] `publish = false` on `pkix-difftest/Cargo.toml`.
- [ ] No new deps added to `pkix-path` itself.

## Out of scope

- OpenSSL or pyca oracles (separate children).
- Corpus loaders other than the single-chain one.
- Verdict classifier (separate child).

## Test fixtures

Embed two minimal chains under `pkix-difftest/tests/fixtures/`:
- `good-chain.pem` — a known-good chain (e.g., extract one from PKITS `Test1` — root-EE).
- `bad-chain.pem` — a known-bad chain (e.g., PKITS Test2 with bad signature).

These are smoke fixtures, not the main corpus.
